items.html: And behold, when Hochma of Arich coupled, in the secret of kissing, with its Malchut — which is Bina in relation to the whole of Arich, and which is the throat, as mentioned — in order to beget AVI and bring them forth so that they would clothe Arich, from his throat down to his Tabur, as mentioned: then the drop of that begetting went out from the name AB that is in this Hochma, for the drop of seed is always drawn only from there, and that drop was the discernment of AVI. And Hochma gave it to Bina, which is always the secret of the throat, in every place, according to whatever discernment it may be. And this Bina is the name SAG, and that drop clothed there in the secret of pregnancy. Then AVI came out there from the aforementioned throat, and the two of them came out equal, ‘as one they go out, as one they dwell,’ etc. And the reason for this is that they came out from the name SAG alone, which is the throat, as mentioned.
